text:
Market light RED (VIX 31.5): an AI-led sell-off has spread to every sector this week. The S&P 500 is -5% and chips -11%. No new weekly-pick buys while the light is RED. The index core (VOO) may still be bought in batches.
NVDA reported record quarterly revenue on 19 Nov, but the stock still fell with the AI trade. It is -12.7% vs entry and still well above the 108.64 disaster stop. AMD is -10.7%, in line with the market.
CRWD rose 5.9% this week while the market fell about 10%, a good moment to complete Monday's sell. SNOW fell with the market; its sell still stands.
Holding 54% cash kept the account at +0.5% since the plan started, against the S&P 500 at -2.6%.

cautions.why: Even after record results the stock fell; the AI trade is under pressure and the position is about 12% of the account.
